name: ibis budget Jakarta Cikini
short_description: A 150-room budget hotel on Jalan Cikini Raya, 100m from the Taman Ismail Marzuki cultural arts centre in Central Jakarta.
ai_summary: ibis budget Jakarta Cikini is a 2-star economy hotel at Jalan Cikini Raya No 75, right next to the Taman Ismail Marzuki cultural arts centre and the Pasar Cikini shopping strip in Central Jakarta, about 4.5 km (roughly 20 minutes on foot or 8 minutes by car) from Gambir Railway Station. This is a distinct, separate property from the higher-tier Novotel Jakarta Cikini and Mercure Jakarta Cikini hotels in the same neighborhood. The 150-room property offers three room types with the newer ibis bedding concept, a single meeting room, and breakfast included in most rates. Its own Accor listing shows a 4.7/5 ALL rating from 265 reviews, with location and service scoring highest (9.2/10 and 9/10) while room and cleanliness scores trail lower (5.3/10 and 4.1/10), and independent 2024-2025 reviews echo this split -- praising the central location and friendly staff while repeatedly flagging inconsistent housekeeping, including reports of insects in some rooms. The hotel does not participate in the ALL - Accor Live Limitless loyalty programme.

faqs.question: Is ibis budget Jakarta Cikini part of the ALL loyalty programme?
faqs.answer: No -- despite the ibis budget/Accor branding, this hotel's own Accor listing confirms it does not participate in the ALL - Accor Live Limitless loyalty programme, so members cannot earn or redeem points or elite benefits here, though ALL member rates may still apply when booking.

faqs.question: Is ibis budget Jakarta Cikini the same hotel as Novotel Jakarta Cikini or Mercure Jakarta Cikini?
faqs.answer: No -- all three are separate, distinct Accor-branded properties in the same Cikini neighborhood of Central Jakarta. ibis budget Jakarta Cikini is the economy-tier option, while Novotel Jakarta Cikini and Mercure Jakarta Cikini are separate mid-to-upscale hotels, so travelers should double-check the exact property name when booking.

faqs.question: What are guests' main complaints about ibis budget Jakarta Cikini?
faqs.answer: The hotel's own listing shows a wide gap between a strong 9.2/10 location score and just 4.1/10 for cleanliness. Multiple independent 2024-2025 reviews report inconsistent housekeeping, including insects in some rooms and smelly linens, even though staff service and the central location near Taman Ismail Marzuki are consistently praised.
